Chapter 707 - 707 Great Dao Fragments; Stone Spirit Transformation

Chapter 707 - 707 Great Dao Fragments; Stone Spirit Transformation

707 Great Dao Fragments; Stone Spirit Transformation

Lin Fan had never thought that he could get rewards if he gave up a mission.

These gains were simply free.

It was the happiest thing to pick up something for free.

Lin Fan smiled faintly.

Then, he turned his attention to the Fire Spirit Crystal.

[Fire Spirit Crystal: A crystal that contains a huge amount of fire attribute energy.]

Lin Fan took out his spirit stones and spirit crystals. Then, he carved out a formation around him and started to absorb the energy within the Fire Spirit Crystal.

Suddenly, his entire body seemed to be burning with raging flames. His body continued to grow and emitted an incomparably powerful aura. It was as if he had become a vast and sacred Fire God King, making people feel like prostrating themselves in worship.

In the blink of an eye, a month had passed.

The Fire Spirit Crystal let out a soft sound, and its surface exploded.

Then, like a bubble, it turned into nothingness.

At the same time, a terrifying aura that was like a tsunami spread out from Lin Fan’s body.

Every corner of the earth was stirred up by the storm.

Day turned into night, and the stars shone brightly.

Night turned into day, and the sun and moon were in the sky.

They kept rotating, and it was extremely magical.

This scene immediately caused many people to discuss.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, your cultivation has reached level-one Universe.]

[Ding! Congratulations on breaking through to the Universe level. You’ve obtained Golden Dragon Body Protection Armor (Emeperor), Emperor-Level Equipment Upgrade Gem x1, Universe in the Palm (Emperor), Great Dao fragment.]

[Golden Dragon Body Protection Armor: Emperor-tier equipment. It has powerful defense and can block all attacks below the Emperor-tier.]

Lin Fan picked up the armor with the golden dragon and slowly put it on.

Immediately, his body emitted an incomparably dazzling golden light.

The golden light continued to gather, turning into a giant golden dragon that roared into the sky.

[King-Level Equipment Upgrade Gem: A magical gem that can upgrade King-level equipment to Emperor-level.]

Lin Fan thought for a moment before taking out the True Dragon Sword.

[Ding! True Dragon Sword upgraded successfully!]

A loud dragon roar came from the True Dragon Sword.

A vast aura surged in all directions.

[Universe in the Palm: Emperor-level cultivation technique. A powerful and mysterious cultivation technique. The palm is like the universe, possessing the power to trap and crush everything.]

Lin Fan raised his right hand slowly.

The sky, which had just regained its brightness, turned dark again.

Starlight flowed, incomparably resplendent.

Lin Fan had a very strong feeling that if he wanted to, he could just move his finger.

Earth, and even the planets around Earth, would be crushed into pieces.

[Great Dao fragment: A fragment of the Great Dao. It’s mysterious and unfathomable. It has a special treasure that can increase the aptitude of a world’s living beings.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes flickered.

Increase the aptitude of a world’s living beings?

Global cultivation?

Everyone would be able to cultivate?

This was definitely a very good treasure.

Although it was called a fragment, it was actually as tall as a small mountain.

Lin Fan raised his hand and placed it beside the Path-Understanding Tree.

In an instant, everyone in the world, including the small fish in the water and the animals in the forest… They all had a very strange feeling. They were ethereal and relaxed.

Their eyes became bright, their strength began to increase, and their reaction became more sensitive…

Hu Tian felt the energy circulating smoothly in her body and could not help but ask, “Lin Fan, you broke through again?”

Lin Fan smiled and nodded. “Yes.”

When everyone heard that, their gazes toward Lin Fan became brighter and brighter.

…

It was also at this moment…

In a temple filled with incense.

An old couple with white hair supported each other as they slowly walked forward.

At this moment, the old man suddenly clutched his chest and fell to the ground with cold sweat on his head.

The old woman next to him said in panic, “My husband, my husband!”

However, no matter how she shouted, the old man could not respond.

The old woman panicked and quickly noticed the statue in front of her.

Therefore, she hurriedly knelt on the ground, her forehead touching the ground as she continuously wailed.

“Please, please save my husband!”

Her head hit the ground with a loud thud. It was very miserable and sorrowful.

It was as if her actions had aroused the pity of the statue.

The old man’s body suddenly emitted wisps of light, which were very mysterious.

The next moment, he stood up with a flushed face.

This change immediately attracted the attention of many people around him, and they all let out gasps of praise.

“The god has appeared!”

“Greetings!”

“Greetings!”

Everyone at the scene kowtowed and shouted.

Soon, this temple became famous, and the smell of incense became even stronger.

Similar things happened. Some people could suddenly fly, some could control the weather, and some could turn into water…

Few people knew that the Great Dao fragment had increased their talent.

…

Time flowed like water. In the blink of an eye, five years had passed.

Under Lin Fan’s relentless cultivation, his cultivation state had finally reached level-two Universe.

On this day, the saint stone placed next to the Great Dao fragment suddenly emitted a brilliant light like the sun.

Then, like an egg, cracks appeared on its surface.

In the end, it shattered.

When the light slowly disappeared, a one-meter-tall boy appeared.

[Ding! Innate Saint Stone Spirit detected.]

[Innate Saint Stone Spirit: A living being nurtured by a saint stone and favored by heaven and earth.]

When everyone saw him, they all revealed puzzled and curious expressions.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s body flashed and appeared before the Innate Saint Stone Spirit.

The Innate Saint Stone Spirit bowed slightly.

Even though he had always been in stone form, he also had his own consciousness.

Lin Fan nodded. “Do you have a name?”

“No, I don’t,” the Innate Saint Stone Spirit said.

“Then you shall be called Lil Stone,” Lin Fan said.

“Yes, Master,” Lil Stone said.

Then, Lin Fan briefly explained the origins of Lil Stone.

When everyone heard this, they all revealed surprised expressions.

A stone could turn into a human?

Could the legend of Sun Wukong in Journey to the West be true?

Everyone surrounded Lil Stone and asked questions.

Thus, the huge Coiling Dragon Villa was filled with laughter and joy as another child had appeared.

…

The central region of the Four Seasons Universe, Heaven Palace.

Many men and women who were emitting powerful auras gathered together. They either greeted each other or discussed in low voices.

At this moment, a 30,000-meter-tall figure shrouded in golden light appeared at the top.

When he appeared, the entire hall immediately fell silent.

The atmosphere became extremely solemn.

Then, everyone present bowed in unison and said respectfully, “Greetings, Celestial Thearch!”

The figure shrouded in golden light nodded slightly and said, “Everyone, please rise.”

His voice was extremely loud, majestic, and vast, making people feel even more respectful.
